tensions.name: relaxed
tensions.rule: exactly one strong focal event; the rest of the page releases. Uneven energy, not low energy.

tensions.name: balanced
tensions.rule: one focal event, supporting type remains functional, empty paper stays visible.

tensions.name: assertive
tensions.rule: the phrase or seal is the subject; supporting devices retreat.

focal_events.name: oversized type
focal_events.visible: one word or 2-8 characters occupy the visual center and collide with the object or paper

focal_events.name: extreme crop
focal_events.visible: one object or body fragment crosses at least one page edge and occupies 45%-80%

focal_events.name: overprint collision
focal_events.visible: two plates cross in one zone only; mixed dark is a physical overlap, not a third ink

focal_events.name: abnormal scale
focal_events.visible: one object is giant relative to type or to a second object; the rest stays quiet

focal_events.name: evidence crossing an edge
focal_events.visible: one physical remainder crosses the card, window, or paper edge; solar-polaroid / F13 default

release_zones.name: open paper
release_zones.visible: one large quiet region of unprinted substrate

release_zones.name: pale screening
release_zones.visible: a washed plate or sparse dots, still the same ink

release_zones.name: dark void
release_zones.visible: unprinted black or deep ground as breathing room; F6 / F8 / F2-OP
